name: genesis-wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for PDF text extraction and verification (requires the Rust toolchain with cargo)

scripts.build: sh -c 'command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Rust toolchain with cargo is required."; exit 1; }; cargo build --release'
scripts.build:wasm: sh -c 'command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Rust toolchain with cargo is required."; exit 1; }; cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown'
scripts.test: sh -c 'command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Rust toolchain with cargo is required."; exit 1; }; cargo test'
